subject: Temporary headroom request — launch week (FastLane)
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@fastlane.ai>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary headroom request — launch week (FastLane)

Hi Avery,

We're going live in two days and early traffic tests are showing a short spike window that will likely push us ~3x above our committed quota for ~48 hours. Can Redwood provision a temporary headroom for that window and, if possible, cap the per-token overrun rate so our burn is predictable?

Quick asks:
- Provision ~48h of 2x headroom starting 2026-08-04 00:00 UTC.
- Temporary cap on overrun rate (or confirm current overrun rates).
- A simple stepdown schedule so usage falls back automatically after 48h.

We can sign a short addendum / PO today. Attaching the PO now.

Thanks —
Maya Patel
Head of Ops, FastLane.ai
[Attachment: FastLane_PO_648.pdf (PDF)]
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@fastlane.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary headroom request — launch week (FastLane)

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the PO and heads-up. We can absolutely support a short-term headroom window. A few clarifying items so we align the commercial path: 

1) Headroom size: you asked for 2x for 48 hours — are you confident 48h covers the tail? We can add an automatic 12h buffer if you like.
2) Overrun pricing: standard overrun rate is $0.045/token for your tier; we can offer a capped blended rate of $0.035/token for the 48h window if FastLane commits to the PO and accepts a one-time uplift credit schedule.
3) Stepdown: we can implement an automated throttle to 150% for 6 hours, then back to baseline. Alternatively, we can do a hard cap at baseline at the end of window.

Laura (rev) and Ben (finance) — can you review the blended cap above and confirm approval for a one-time promotional rate for a fast-sign?

If that works I'll send a short addendum and DocuSign link — we can turn this around today.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary headroom request — launch week (FastLane)

Avery — quick take from finance: 

- Blended rate $0.035/token for 48h seems reasonable if we cap total upside exposure. I need the estimate of expected overrun tokens so we can size the credit reserve.
- We should require the PO to reference the deal_id and have an acknowledgement of expected total spend ceiling for the 48h period (FastLane sign-off).
- Approve 12h buffer only if FastLane signs the PO acknowledging potential additional charge beyond the blended cap.

Laura — if legal/ops is comfortable with an automated stepdown (150% then baseline), I can greenlight the cap with a maximum exposure holdback of 15% of monthly invoice to be reconciled in the true-up.

Ben
VP, Finance Operations
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary headroom request — launch week (FastLane)

Thanks — operational notes: 
- We can implement the automated stepdown sequence via routing policy: 200% (immediate), taper to 150% after 36h, then to baseline after 48h. We will also configure the KV cache to warm prior to the window to reduce token cost impact.
- For the blended cap, ops needs explicit expected overrun token estimate and the PO to have the deal_id. Once we have those, we'll stage the config and enable the throttles.

Avery — please ask Maya for the expected overrun estimate (token count and time window). Also request a signed addendum that references the capped blended rate and the reconciliation/true-up terms.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Operations
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya@fastlane.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary headroom request — launch week (FastLane)

Maya — moving fast here. Two quick asks so we can finalize the rate and provision: 

1) Please confirm an estimated overrun in token-hours (e.g., ~12M tokens over 48h) — a range is fine.
2) Please sign the short addendum I attached (one-page) that references: the capped blended overrun rate $0.035/token, automated stepdown schedule, and reconciliation in the month-end true-up. I've also attached a draft with the PO inserted.

If you can reply with those two items we'll issue the DocuSign and stage the headroom change — ops can flip the routing at 00:00 UTC on 2026-08-04.

Best —
Avery
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
